Job Description:

Position Overview
We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Benefits Consultant to join our growing team. This position will support a variety of employee benefits consulting engagements while developing expertise in benefits compliance, data analysis, and client service.

A significant component of this role will be supporting the annual preparation of Affordable Care Act (ACA) Forms 1094 and 1095 for contracted Baker Tilly clients. The Benefits Consultant will work closely with clients and internal team members to gather and validate data, identify and resolve discrepancies, prepare required forms, and help ensure accurate and timely completion of annual ACA reporting requirements.

This position is well suited for an early-career professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, managing detailed processes, and providing high-quality service to clients.

Responsibilities
Benefits Consulting
- Support leadership and project teams on a variety of employee benefits consulting engagements.
- Assist with the collection, organization, review, and analysis of client benefits and employee data.
- Perform research and analysis related to employee benefits programs, compliance requirements, and industry practices.
- Prepare spreadsheets, analyses, client deliverables, presentations, and other project materials.
- Assist with recurring and special client projects, maintaining project schedules and helping ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
- Communicate with clients and internal team members to obtain information, resolve questions, and support project completion.
- Develop knowledge of employee benefit programs and applicable federal and state compliance requirements.

Affordable Care Act Reporting
- Play a key role in the team's annual ACA reporting process, including preparation of Forms 1094-B/C and 1095-B/C for contracted Baker Tilly clients.
- Coordinate with clients to obtain employee, eligibility, enrollment, payroll, and other information necessary to complete ACA reporting.
- Review and validate client-provided data for completeness and consistency and identify potential discrepancies requiring additional investigation.
- Assist with data imports, reconciliation, coding, and preparation of ACA reporting files and forms.
- Work with clients and senior team members to research and resolve data and reporting issues.
- Perform quality-control reviews to support accurate and timely preparation of client filings.
- Track client deliverables, outstanding information, and filing deadlines throughout the annual reporting cycle.
- Assist with corrections and other follow-up activities associated with ACA reporting.
- Maintain organized documentation and appropriately handle confidential employee and benefits information.
- Stay informed of changes to ACA reporting requirements, deadlines, and related guidance.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in business, human resources, economics, data analytics, or a related field preferred.
- One (1) plus years of relevant professional experience are encouraged to apply.
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with an ability to identify inconsistencies in large or complex data sets.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and an interest in developing advanced spreadsheet and data-analysis skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to learn new systems, regulations, and technical concepts quickly.
- Demonstrated commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and high-quality client service.
- Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications
- Previous internship or professional experience in employee benefits, human resources, payroll, accounting, tax, compliance, consulting, or a related field.
- Experience working with large data sets, including data reconciliation and validation.
- Familiarity with employee benefits or Affordable Care Act employer reporting requirements.
- Experience with Excel functions such as lookups, pivot tables, formulas, and data manipulation.

The pay rate range for this job position is $51,200 to $100,680. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Job Description:

Join One of the Fastest-Growing Professional Services Firms in the Nation

Are you passionate about helping clients embrace technology to elevate their business operations and enhance customer satisfaction?

If so, consider joining Baker Tilly US, LLP (BT) as a Sage 100 Contractor Senior Consultant . In this role, you’ll work directly with clients to deliver software solutions through implementation projects and ongoing support—driving high customer satisfaction and successful adoption.

As one of the fastest-growing firms in the country, BT offers:
- A clear path for career advancement
- Flexibility in how and where you work
- Meaningful relationships with clients, teammates, and leaders who genuinely care about your growth and development

What You’ll Do
As a trusted member of the engagement team, you will be expected to:

Interpersonal Functions:
- Provide prompt, concise, and friendly communications providing high quality service
- Utilize time management skills with ability to manage priorities independently and successfully multi-task across projects, customers, and internal activities
- Advocate for clients, team members, and the product
- Work effectively independently and collaboratively in a team environment

Technical Functions:
- Monitor and respond to customer technical issues
- Clearly articulate system functionality through written and oral communication methods
- Coordinate internal and client project team meetings
- Schedule & perform year-end upgrades to client environments
- Have the Ability to: 1) speak to basic concepts of debits/credits  2) easily identify outliers in reviewing financial data 3) support clients with sub-ledger reconciliation process 4) perform gap analysis between system functionality and client requirements including recommendation of alternative applications to achieve similar goals when necessary 5) conduct training for customer end-users at all levels of the customers organization and relate system functionality to customer business requirement
- Advanced proficiency with Excel (pivot tables, vlookups, macros, etc.) for efficient data mapping, integration, and migration of customer data
- Utilize and regularly contribute to team knowledge repository for best practices and lessons learned in form of knowledge base article.
- Any additional assignments as requested by management.

Qualifications
Successful candidates will have:
- A Bachelor's Degree in Accounting (preferred), Business, or MIS (with a foundational understanding of accounting concepts).
- Deep knowledge of the construction industry, including micro-verticals, operational/reporting requirements, and terminology.
- Knowledge of construction-specific payroll requirements.
- At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following:
- Consulting and implementing Sage 100 Contractor, Sage Paperless Construction Software
- Using Sage 100 Contractor in a financial or operational role
- Maintain relevant Sage Certifications
- Experience as a client-facing support consultant (preferred).
- Hands-on experience with full-cycle software delivery or as an end-user during implementation or upgrades (preferred).
- Experience with and ability to perform software updates on Remote Servers
- Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros, etc.) for efficient data mapping, integration, and migration of client data.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
- Eligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

The pay range for this position is $ 97,600 to $ 158,200 . This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Job Description:

We are currently searching for an experienced performance management consultant to join our growing Baker Tilly Digital practice. As a part of Baker Tilly, you will find that our global brand and entrepreneurial environment will give you the support you need to apply your industry and technical experience to build your career across a wide range of services to meet our clients’ important needs. You will contribute to some of the most important activities in our firm which include operating and growing the business, serving the client, developing the best people, and shaping our culture.

Baker Tilly is a Global Systems Integrator (GSI) partner with OneStream. As a member of our team, you will help lead the firm’s efforts in expanding our commercial market presence and provide functional and technical consulting offerings to leading companies and organizations throughout the region and across the country. In this role, you will deliver consulting services involving Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Consolidation, and Business Intelligence solutions to Baker Tilly clients. The position will require everything from business requirements and solution design to technical development. Baker Tilly works with some of the leading organizations of the world to implement successful budgeting and forecasting solutions. During your tenure with Baker Tilly, you will gain deep experience in the business process, industry, and technical aspects of these solutions.

It’s an exciting time to join Baker Tilly!

Responsibilities:
- Utilize application expertise, business knowledge, and technical skills to successfully support design, build, test, and deploy corporate/enterprise performance management (CPM/EPM) solutions to Baker Tilly clients.
- Support client workshops to gather requirements and build client design documentation for OneStream applications and solutions. Assist in the design of a comprehensive infrastructure framework within the OneStream financial application for clients based on requirements documentation.
- Engage in OneStream solution quality and testing, including unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing.
- Build, test & deploy reports, cube views, dashboards, templates and forms to meet client requirements.
- Work with our clients to develop a roadmap that encompasses an overall solution vision and effectively communicate initiatives across the entire project team.
- Identify new areas within the client’s business and forecasting processes where planning software can be better utilized to drive business results and increase the accuracy and efficiency of their budgets and forecasts.

Successful candidates will have:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a closely related field.
- Minimum of three (3) years of experience in FP&A or FP&A consulting, including advising commercial companies and senior leadership.
- Experience implementing OneStream for financial planning or close & consolidation software.
- Previous experience working with external clients, including solution development and implementation using a leading ERP or EPM/CPM solution is a plus.
- OneStream Certified Associate preferred.
- Strong understanding of .NET and SQL development preferred.
- Ability to lead and mentor others, provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of projects.
- Demonstrated leadership, analytical, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills.

The pay range for this position is $78,100 to $126,500. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Solution Delivery

Job Description:

Baker Tilly offers an outstanding career opportunity for a Senior Consultant to join our Strategy and Transformation team; an integral part of our rapidly expanding Digital Solutions practice. Join a dynamic, innovative team driving digital transformation and operational excellence across diverse industries. This role blends expertise in change management, project management, process analysis, and business analysis to deliver impactful solutions, facilitate organizational change, and ensure successful project outcomes.

As a valued member of our Strategy & Transformation team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping transformation  strategy, transformation programs and delivering impactful change initiatives for leading organizations. You’ll collaborate with top talent to solve complex enterprise challenges, leveraging deep functional, industry, and technical expertise. Our flexible engagement model empowers you to drive meaningful results, helping clients achieve lasting success in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

You will enjoy this role if you :
•    Are seeking your next challenge, thrive on variety, and want your skills and experience to be fully utilized across diverse projects and programs.
•    Want to be part of a fast-growing, innovative practice where your hard work, creativity, and leadership in program and project management help us build, improve, and advance our solutions.
•    Have a passion for leading change—enabling organizations to meet objectives on time and on budget by driving adoption, optimizing processes, and delivering successful transformation initiatives.
•    Enjoy working with a variety of clients to analyze business needs, design and implement effective processes, and facilitate seamless information sharing across all components of the organization.
•    Are a team player with strong communication skills, eager to collaborate with others to meet client needs, and comfortable managing cross-functional teams and complex programs.
•    Excel when you’re part of a talented, down-to-earth team that thrives on collaboration, values diverse perspectives, and truly enjoys working together to solve business challenges.
•    Feel valued when provided with the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical, analytical, and leadership skills—building your career for today and tomorrow.

What you will do :
•    Manage and develop change management strategies and plans aligned to core change management methodology
•    Integrate appropriate change management techniques into established plans
•    Execute change management plan(s) and associated activities including stakeholder analysis and management, organizational readiness assessments, change impact analysis, communications and training
•    Work as the overall advocate to various stakeholders relative to implications of the future state on strategy, people, process and technology
•    Deploy change management techniques (e.g. communication, training, focus groups and many more techniques) to assist in the transition to the future state
•    Work as the overall advocate to various stakeholders relative to implications of the future state on strategy, people, process and technology. Lead the identification of organizational change risks and, collaboratively with stakeholders, develop mitigation approaches
•    Gather and analyze detailed information about the process design and the impact on the roles and the organizations affected. Understand the significance of changes to provide recommendations regarding expected organization impacts, and how to prepare the organization
•    Manage the delivery of end-user training, communications and subsequent follow-up activities, including effectiveness assessment
•    Generate and maintain advocacy at the executive level of the respective organizations and stakeholder buy-in for the implementation project
•    Support the impacted businesses with information and detailed frameworks, where appropriate, to ensure that they can conduct the necessary activities to minimize organizational risks
•    Measure effectiveness of change management plans and make adjustments where necessary
•    Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with clients and the community
•    Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
•    Support the growth and development of team members and clients through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals
•    Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance
Change Management

Job Description:

We are currently searching for a  Senior Consultant  to join our Financial Advisory Services practice within the CFO Advisory team. Our practice helps CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Directors improve the financial reporting processes to ensure that finance adds value to business operations.  The CFO Advisory practice enables finance executives to achieve significant and sustainable performance through technical analysis and process improvement services.

Our clients range from emerging growth companies to publicly traded companies.  We serve a wide variety of industries including technology, business services, manufacturing/ distribution, energy, real estate, hospitality and retail, and private equity to name a few.

Baker Tilly's CFO Advisory Services team is comprised of practitioners across the country. Our goal is to solve problems or make improvements that will free the finance organization up so that they can focus on growing and improving their overall business.

This practice area has professionals with multi-disciplines and experiences that are drawn upon to assist our clients with very practical and hands-on support.  We have senior team members that have served as Chief Financial Officers, Controllers, financial statement auditors, and financial analysts that are all highly credentialed.  It is a high performing team that enjoys learning from one another and serving our clients.

Your immediate responsibilities will be to:
- Actively participate in projects focused on the following service offerings:
- Finance Performance Improvement

- Business Analytics and Decision Support

- Financial Accounting Advisory Services

- Transaction Support

- Program/Project Management

- Participate actively in the team’s work on a project (i.e. “roll up your sleeves” and work with the team)

- Interact directly with managers and partners on matters related to client and engagement management

- Strengthen existing client relationships by providing outstanding client service

- Communicate with business owners, executive management, investors, lenders and other sophisticated parties to ensure delivery of exceptional client service

- Invest in professional development through active participation in training sessions and networking events both internally and externally

- Assist with recruiting activities to include campus recruiting along with referring experienced individuals to the firm and participating in the firm's Employee Referral Bonus Program

- Demonstrate excellent team skills, positive attitude and high ethical standards

Successful candidates will have:
- Two (2) plus years' experience in a large accounting firm in audit, financial advisory service line

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related field

- Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification preferred

- Knowledge and ability to use appropriate tools, applications, and accounting and finance concepts to facilitate analysis. Skills with Power BI and/ or Tableau is a plus.

- Exposure to Middle Market financial suite of applications, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, IntAcct, etc. , their functionality, workflows, automated controls, and associated facilitation of data consolidation, reporting, and robust analytics and their relationship to addressing myriad business requirements is a plus.

- High motivation, initiative and positive attitude

- Excellent organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to multitask and handle multiple priorities appropriately

- Intermediate modeling and excel skills, experience conducting complex quantitative
and qualitative financial analysis and ability to generate data-driven insights

- Ability to work autonomously, to meet tight deadlines, and to thrive in a fast paced
environment with shifting priorities

- Excellent verbal and written communication

- Ability to work effectively and thrive in a team environment

- Ability to Travel (apx 25%) and work in a hybrid work environment

- The compensation range for this role is $86,660 to $164,300. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Job Description:

Responsibilities

It’s an exciting time to join Baker Tilly!

Baker Tilly has an incredible career opportunity for a Senior Consultant, Forensic Accountant to join our growing Singapore Forensics, Litigation & Valuation Services (FLVS) team. As a part of our team, you will find that our global brand and entrepreneurial environment will give you the support you need to build your career across a wide range of forensic and litigation services to meet our client’s most important needs. You will also contribute to some of the most important activities in our firm which include operating and growing the business, serving the client, developing the best people, and shaping our culture.

Senior Consultants on our FLVS team will conduct and prepare a wide range of forensic financial analyses. A Forensic Accountant has a unique job which requires strong analytical, creative, investigative, research, communication, and organisational skills, as well as familiarity with a variety of the field’s concepts, practices, and procedures. Forensic Accountants will maintain excellent client relationships by delivering high quality client service.

You will enjoy this role if:

- You are looking for your next challenge, crave variety where no day is the same, and feel your skills and experience can be better utilised.
- You maintain excellent client relationships by delivering the highest level of client service.
- You are a team player with strong communication skills and desire to work collaboratively with others to meet client needs.
- You are naturally curious, able to spot the unusual, and have a tenacity to discover the cause.
- You have a willingness to look at detail, without missing or losing the ‘big picture’.
- You have a readiness to accept that everything one does might be challenged and have the confidence and resilience to handle this as well as pressure and deadlines.
- You have proven industry experience outside traditional accounting i.e. energy, mining or construction sectors.
- You feel valued when you are provided the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

Job Description:

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest-growing advisory practices in the country?
Baker Tilly is seeking a Principal to help grow our Office of the CFO (OCFO) Advisory practice. This role is designed for an experienced advisor, auditor, consultant, or finance leader who combines a deep understanding of high-performing finance organizations and how the role of the Office of the CFO is evolving in response to growth, complexity, and rising stakeholder expectations with a proven ability to develop business, drive growth, build client relationships, and lead high-performing teams.
Our OCFO Advisory practice partners with CFOs, finance leaders, private equity sponsors, and portfolio company executives to strengthen finance organizations, enhance the effectiveness of accounting and finance leadership, and build the organizational capabilities required to support growth. Clients rely on us to modernize and elevate the Office of the CFO, improve reporting and decision support, navigate critical business events, and position finance organizations to operate more strategically and at greater scale. We support clients across the business lifecycle, including periods of rapid growth, acquisitions, divestitures, integrations, finance transformation initiatives, capital raises, and other strategic transactions.
As a Principal, you will serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership teams while helping shape the future growth of the practice. You will work closely with firm leadership to expand market presence, deepen client relationships, develop talent, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients.

You Will Enjoy This Role If:
- You are energized by helping CFOs and finance leaders strengthen and transform their finance organizations.
- You enjoy building trusted relationships with CFOs, CEOs, boards, private equity sponsors, and portfolio company executives.
- You are entrepreneurial and motivated by developing new business opportunities and growing advisory services.
- You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy helping organizations navigate growth, transactions, and transformation.
- You are passionate about mentoring professionals and building high-performing teams.
- You enjoy balancing strategic leadership responsibilities with hands-on client engagement.

What You Will Do:
- Lead and oversee Office of the CFO engagements across a variety of industries and business environments.
- Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, finance leaders, private equity firms, and portfolio company management teams.
- Lead projects involving finance transformation, process improvement, financial reporting modernization, technical accounting, and systems enablement.
- Advise clients through acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, integrations, and other strategic transactions.
- Support transaction-related activities, including financial due diligence readiness, accounting assessments, integration planning, and post-close execution.
- Help clients design, build, and scale high-performing finance organizations capable of supporting growth, increasing complexity, and evolving stakeholder expectations.
- Lead client engagements involving technical accounting, financial reporting, SEC reporting, and IPO readiness when needed.
- Deliver insights and recommendations that improve financial performance, operational effectiveness, and decision-making.
- Identify opportunities to expand relationships and deliver additional value across Baker Tilly’s advisory platform.
- Develop and execute business development strategies to drive revenue growth, expand client relationships, and increase market presence.
- Build relationships with private equity sponsors, investment professionals, attorneys, lenders, and other referral sources.
- Lead cross-functional engagement teams while ensuring exceptional client service and successful project execution.
- Mentor, coach, and develop team members, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.
- CPA preferred; CFA, MBA, or other relevant credentials are a plus.
- 15+ years of experience across audit, accounting advisory, consulting, transaction advisory, and/or Office of the CFO services.
- Demonstrated success developing executive-level relationships and originating advisory opportunities with private equity sponsors and portfolio companies, business owners, CFOs, and finance leaders. Experience supporting clients through acquisitions, integrations, finance transformation initiatives, and value creation programs.
- Strong knowledge of finance organizations, controllership, financial reporting, finance transformation, and accounting operations.
- Experience with SEC reporting, IPO readiness, or public company environments is a plus.
- Proven success developing, selling, and growing advisory services.
- Strong leadership, relationship management, communication, and project management skills.
- Ability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels while delivering exceptional client service.

The Ideal Candidate:
The ideal candidate is a proven leader from audit, accounting advisory, consulting, or other client-service environments, or a finance executive with meaningful advisory or consulting experience, who has built trusted relationships with CFOs, finance leaders, and business executives and has a demonstrated track record of developing business and driving growth. They bring a deep understanding of high-performing finance organizations and the evolving role of the Office of the CFO, along with experience leading advisory, consulting, or other client-facing engagements. They have the ability to lead client engagements, mentor teams, and expand advisory relationships. They are comfortable advising executive leadership teams, helping organizations navigate growth and transformation, and delivering meaningful outcomes across complex accounting and finance initiatives.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly is seeking a Senior Human Resources (HR) Consultant  to join its Managed Services team and serve as a trusted advisor to clients across the full spectrum of human resources. This is a highly visible, client-facing role requiring broad HR expertise, strong business acumen, exceptional communication and presentation skills, and the ability to translate HR challenges into practical, effective solutions.

The ideal candidate is an experienced HR professional who enjoys variety, builds credibility quickly, and thrives in a fast-paced consulting environment. This individual must be highly organized, responsive, comfortable managing multiple client priorities, and accustomed to the accountability associated with a professional services environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Independently manage multiple client relationships and consulting engagements.
- Lead projects involving compensation, compliance, succession planning, talent management, performance management, HR operations, and policy development.
- Advise clients on sensitive employee relations and workplace matters.
- Develop and present recommendations to executive and leadership teams.
- Facilitate meetings, workshops, training, and other client sessions.
- Develop HR policies, programs, processes, tools, and resources.
- Manage projects, deadlines, deliverables, and changing client priorities.
- Maintain exceptional responsiveness and follow-through with clients.
- Effectively manage billable-hour expectations, project budgets, utilization goals, and timely, accurate time tracking.
- Collaborate with colleagues and subject-matter experts to bring the right solutions to clients.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience considered in lieu of a degree.
- 3 years of progressive HR experience across multiple HR disciplines.

- Strong knowledge of compensation, employment compliance, employee relations, talent management, succession planning, HR operations, and policy development.
- Experience advising leaders and navigating complex or sensitive HR situations.

- Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels.

- Strong business judgment and the ability to build credibility quickly with clients and senior leaders.
- Outstanding organizational and project-management skills.
- The ability to manage multiple clients, projects, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- A highly responsive, proactive, and client-focused approach.
- Experience working within a consulting, professional services, or other client-service environment preferred.
- Familiarity with billable hours, utilization expectations, project budgets, and time tracking strongly preferred.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel skills for data analysis and reporting.

- Professional certification (HRCI or SHRM) preferred.

Internal Job Description
Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the area of informational technology risk advisory?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a FedRAMP Senior Assessor! Our Risk Advisory practice provides a full spectrum of services to help our clients assess their risks, develop strategies to compete in an ever-changing business environment, and achieve their goals and objectives.  All of this is accomplished through deep industry knowledge of risk, governance, internal audit, compliance, IT, and cybersecurity best practices.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

- Lead advisory and assessment engagements
- Conduct gap analyses

- Three (3) years of experience

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Proven commitment to providing exceptional client service (internal and external)

Job Description:

Our Purpose:

Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry for middle market (company with revenue btw $200 million to $5 billion) in which middle market financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing and secure.  If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then join our dynamic growing team.  We help client with transactions life cycle (IPO, SPAC, merger, divesture), implement new accounting (US GAAP or IFRS) or regulatory rules, implement or remediate internal controls and transform or digitize their finance functions as well as implement ESG, etc...  Sounds interesting?  If this is you, please reach out to us to discuss further your interest and qualifications.

The opportunity:

Our Financial Advisory Services (FAS) team is growing exponentially and as a Manager you’ll play a key role in that growth to help us achieve our vision 2030. Strategy 2030 will navigate us toward our objective of becoming the leading middle market advisory firm, growing to $5 billion and continuing to ascent in the profession.  Working across all key financial service sectors, you’ll develop your career by communicating creative, strategic goals both internally and externally. It’s all about listening to and understanding our middle market clients to give them a truly exceptional client experience in a field where there really are no off-the-shelf recommendations.

Baker Tilly is currently searching for a Senior Consultant to join our FAS practice. Our practice helps CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Directors improve the financial reporting processes to ensure that finance adds value to business operations.  The FAS practice enables finance executives to achieve significant and sustainable performance through technical analysis and process improvement services.

Our clients range from emerging growth companies to publicly traded companies across financial service sectors. Baker Tilly's FAS team is comprised of practitioners across the country. Our goal is to solve problems or make improvements that will free the finance organization up so that they can focus on growing and improving their overall business.

This practice area has professionals with multi-disciplines and experiences that are drawn upon to assist our clients with very practical and hands-on support.  We have senior team members that have served as Chief Financial Officers, Controllers, financial statement auditors, and financial analysts that are all highly credentialed. It is a high performing team that enjoys learning from one another and serving our clients.

Your responsibilities:
- Support projects focused on the following service offerings in financial services

- US GAAP Advisory

- Business Analytics and Decision Support

- Financial Accounting Advisory Services

- Transaction Support

- Finance transformation

- Program/Project Management

- Support business owners, executive management, investors, lenders and other sophisticated parties to ensure delivery of exceptional client service

- Be accessible and anticipate client needs, questions, and issues

- Invest in professional development through active participation in training sessions and networking events both internally and externally

- Provide support with recruiting activities to include campus recruiting along with referring experienced individuals to the firm and participating in the firm's Employee Referral Bonus Program

- Contribute to firm’s efforts to attract, retain, and develop staff and seniors and act as mentor for other senior & staff

- Demonstrate excellent team skills, positive attitude and high ethical standards

- Lead by example to positively impact employee morale to help build and maintain our inclusive culture

- Develop and maintain relationships with colleagues in the office, other service lines, and engagement/project teams

- Regularly look for opportunities, recommendations, and additional firm services that could benefit or add value to our clients

Successful candidates will have:
- 3+ years' experience in a large accounting firm in audit, financial advisory service line in financial services industry

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related

- Certified public accountant (CPA), or CMA preferred

- Knowledge and ability to use appropriate tools, applications, and accounting and finance concepts to facilitate analysis. Skills with Power BI and/ or Tableau is a plus.

- Current US GAAP and/or IFRS advisory knowledge and application

- Exposure to Middle Market financial suite of applications, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, IntAcct, etc. , their functionality, workflows, automated controls, and associated facilitation of data consolidation, reporting, and robust analytics and their relationship to addressing myriad business requirements

- High motivation, initiative and positive attitude

- Strong organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to multitask and handle multiple priorities appropriately

- Advanced modeling and excel skills, experience conducting complex quantitative and qualitative financial analysis and ability to generate data-driven insights

- Ability to work autonomously, to meet tight deadlines, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

- Excellent verbal and written communication, experience presenting analyses to management and ability to lead and drive initiatives

- Ability to work effectively and thrive in a team environment with all levels of client personnel in various industries

- Ability to comfortably interact with senior level client personnel, including supporting the preparation of and participating in executive briefings

What we look for:

We’re interested in versatile people with the ability to take on new responsibilities and listen to clients to get things done. We’re not just looking for technical accounting experience but broader controllership and operational experience including finance transformation — we’re after genuinely interesting people with the ability to build relationships, negotiate and think in unique and creative news ways. If you’re a confident leader with a curious mind and the ability to solve complex issues, this role is for you.

The compensation range for this role is $86,660 to $164,300. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly has an incredible career opportunity for a Strategic Transformation Leader to join our growing team.

Baker Tilly’s Strategy & Transformation Practice combines deep functional, industry, and technical capabilities to help clients solve their toughest enterprise challenges. Baker Tilly is focused on the integration of advanced technologies with core business transformational services to support companies in successfully navigating the complexities of transformations.

You Will Enjoy This Role If You
- You are looking for your next challenge, crave variety where no day is the same and feel your skills and experience can be better utilized
- You are looking to make an impact as part of a fast growing, innovative practice where your hard work and creativity can help us continue to build our brand as a firm
- You have a passion for leading transformation, enabling an organization to meet objectives on time and on budget
- You do your best work when you are part of a talented, down-to-earth team that thrives in collaboration and truly enjoys working together to meet client needs in a variety of industries
- You feel valued when you are provided the resources and support to continually sharpen your skills and build your career now, for tomorrow

What You Will Do
- Lead a team of Baker Tilly and client resources through strategy definition, future state visioning, target operating model, roadmap development and delivery of transformation projects which may include business process and/or technology implementations
- Utilize finance, accounting, industry, and operational knowledge to assist clients in transforming their organization to align with strategic goals, establish target operating models in alignment to industry standards and benchmarks. Lead the build and definition of operational metrics, roles and responsibilities and organizational structures to support.
- Develop and standardize finance processes, manage contract financial compliance, and document policies and procedures
- Define roles and responsibilities within the organization, establish reporting structures, and ensure effective governance mechanisms
- Lead through transformative solution visioning and execution of the vision, including defining the future state organization. This encompasses designing the target operating model, aligning it with industry standards and benchmarks, and building clear roles and responsibilities, operational metrics, and organizational structures to support and enable the organization
- Evaluate the current state, identify gaps, and provide strategic recommendations to optimize and mature the client’s operating model
- Develop, manage, and measure effectiveness of project approach and plans aligned to critical phases of implementation (analyze, design, build, test, deploy) and/or long-term roadmaps which deliver transformative operating models via a series of projects
- Elicit and define requirements using multiple methods such as interviews, document analysis, workshops, surveys, site visits, etc.
- Ensure compliance with federal financial regulations and mitigate financial, operational, and regulatory risks
- Manage and implement multiple projects through delegation, coordination, communication, and organization. Coordinate deployment of projects included staffing resources, deadlines, and end user expectations
- Ensure that all projects are properly documented, which includes a business case, business requirements, and implementation plan, maintaining document requirements for project managers and business owners
- Manage third party vendor relationships to resource specific development needs
- Act as the liaison among the executive committee members, stakeholders, and development team including identification and mitigation of project risks and issues
- Support the development of the practice from go-to-market activities to delivery methodology standards and team development
- Provide functional expertise based on your specific skills and background
- Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with clients and the community
- Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
- Support the growth and development of team members and clients through the Baker Tilly Value Architect model, helping associates meet their professional goals
- Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance

Successful candidates will have:
- Bachelor’s degree in relevant field
- Minimum of twelve (12) years of related experience; previous related industry and consulting experience highly preferred
- Demonstrated leadership in an industry such as Public Sector (state/local), Not for Profit, and/or Higher Education
- Experience managing senior-level client relationships and working across an organization with multiple stakeholders
- Extensive finance and accounting expertise with a proven track record in helping clients optimize and develop their finance organizations
- Ability to lead and supervise others, provide exceptional client service, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of projects
- Ability to decompose scope into detailed activities and deliverables, then conduct work package handoff to delivery resources from Baker Tilly, client teams, and third-party vendors
- Ability to manage multiple projects/initiatives simultaneously, with a willingness to support different workstreams as needed
- Ability to think creatively to solve problems gained through prior experience, education, training to resolve issues and remove project obstacles
- Demonstrated management, analytical, organization, interpersonal, project management, communication, and highly developed Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) skills
- Project experience with full lifecycle application development (e.g. requirements gathering, use case development, system analysis and design, integration, testing, deployment)
- Experience with enterprise technology system implementation and management
- Project/program management certification (e.g. PMP, PgMP) and/or Agile certification (e.g. PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM. SAFe POPM) is a plus
- Ability to travel as needed and work outside of core business hours for client engagements

The pay range for this position is $155,00 to $312,200. Job Description:

Utilities are navigating significant financial and strategic demands, including major capital investment needs, affordability pressures, evolving regulations, changing consumption patterns, workforce constraints, and increasing expectations for resilient and reliable service. Baker Tilly continues to invest in helping utility organizations make sound financial decisions, align resources with long-term priorities, and deliver sustainable value to customers and communities.

As part of Baker Tilly's Public and Non-Profit Consulting practice, the Managing Director, Municipal Utility Advisory Practice will lead and expand a nationally recognized municipal utility finance and advisory platform. The successful candidate will combine deep utility expertise, proven practice-building experience, strong executive relationships, and entrepreneurial leadership.
This individual will set market strategy, broaden and connect Baker Tilly's utility advisory capabilities, originate and lead complex engagements, develop scalable solutions, expand revenue, build talent, and cultivate executive-level client relationships nationwide. The role will work across utility finance, rates and cost of service, strategic planning, capital and infrastructure, organizational performance, workforce, governance, technology, and operational improvement to deliver integrated solutions for municipally operated water, wastewater, stormwater, electric and gas utilities.

Responsibilities
Lead National Practice Growth
- Develop and execute a national growth strategy for Baker Tilly's municipal utility advisory practice.

- Establish Baker Tilly as a recognized market leader in utility finance, rates, financial planning, and strategic advisory services.

- Drive growth through new client acquisition, geographic expansion, strategic account development, and collaboration across existing client relationships.

- Define priority markets, client segments, service offerings, and investment needs for sustainable national scale.

- Monitor emerging financial, regulatory, operational, infrastructure, technology, and workforce trends affecting utilities.

Build Market-Leading Utility Solutions
- Expand and connect Baker Tilly's utility advisory offerings into a cohesive, scalable national platform.

- Develop repeatable methods, tools, models, and client solutions across utility types and geographies.

- Lead or oversee solutions addressing:

- Utility rate studies and rate design

- Cost-of-service and revenue requirement analysis

- Long-range financial planning and forecasting

- Capital funding and financial strategy

- Scenario analysis, affordability, and financial sustainability

- Strategic planning and implementation

- Performance management, benchmarking, and organizational alignment

- Regulatory and financial advisory services

- Collaborate with leaders across capital and infrastructure, organizational performance, workforce, governance, grants, technology, and operational improvement to create integrated client solutions.

Business Development & Market Leadership
- Develop and maintain executive-level relationships with utility general managers, chief financial officers, finance directors, utility directors, boards, regulators, and other industry leaders.

- Originate, shape, and lead complex utility advisory engagements.

- Lead strategic pursuits, proposals, presentations, and account development efforts.

- Represent Baker Tilly through industry conferences, professional associations, publications, research, and other thought leadership.

- Build referral networks and strategic partnerships that strengthen market reach and capabilities.

- Translate market insight and client needs into new offerings and sustained revenue growth.

Client Delivery & Technical Leadership
- Serve as an executive advisor to utility leadership teams and governing bodies on financial and strategic decisions.

- Provide technical direction and quality oversight for complex engagements involving rates, cost of service, financial models, capital needs, and long-term strategy.

- Communicate complex financial and operational issues in clear, decision-ready terms for executives, boards, and public audiences.

- Ensure recommendations are practical, analytically sound, and responsive to regulatory, customer, affordability, and implementation considerations.

- Balance direct engagement leadership with development of a broader delivery team and consistent national methods.

Talent & Team Development
- Recruit, develop, and retain top utility advisory talent.

- Build and leverage a scalable national team capable of delivering consistent, high-quality services across markets and utility types.

- Mentor emerging leaders and create clear opportunities for technical and business-development growth.

- Connect professionals across disciplines and geographies to deploy the best team for each client need.

- Foster a collaborative, entrepreneurial, innovative, and client-focused culture.

Practice Leadership
- Establish practice goals, performance measures, investment priorities, and growth plans.

- Develop delivery standards, quality-control practices, pricing approaches, and resource models that support profitable scale.

- Identify opportunities to create repeatable, technology-enabled, and potentially recurring advisory offerings.

- Collaborate with marketing and firm leadership to strengthen market visibility and thought leadership.

- Support strategic priorities across Baker Tilly's Public and Non-Profit Consulting practice.

Qualifications
Required
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, engineering, public administration, business administration, public policy, or a related field.

- 10 - 15 years of experience serving utilities through consulting, advisory services, utility leadership, public finance, regulatory work, or a related field.

- Demonstrated success building and scaling a consulting practice, service line, or advisory business.

- Demonstrated success generating significant revenue growth, originating work, and developing new client relationships.

- Deep expertise in utility rates, cost-of-service analysis, financial modeling, and long-range financial planning.

- Experience advising utility executives and governing bodies on strategic, financial, capital, or organizational decisions.

- Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and complex advisory engagements.

- Strong executive-level communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.

- Ability to travel nationally based on client and business-development needs.

Preferred
- Experience leading a regional or national utility consulting practice.

- Established professional network among utility executives, finance leaders, board members, regulators, and industry partners.

- Experience across multiple utility sectors, such as water, wastewater, stormwater, electric, gas, or public power.

- Experience integrating rates and financial analysis with strategic planning, capital planning, affordability, performance management, or organizational advisory services.

- Experience developing proprietary methodologies, analytical tools, market-facing service offerings, or recurring advisory solutions.

- Active involvement in utility-focused professional associations and conferences.

- Graduate degree or relevant professional credential preferred.

The pay rate range for this job position is $215,950 to $409,420. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Job Description:

Do you have experience in the world of servicing the Public Sector and are searching for your next challenge? Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing public accounting firms?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP (BT) as a Senior Consultant ! Our practice recognizes the unique challenges of public entities providing consulting for various public sector entities, including state, local, and tribal governments as well as public utilities and K-12 schools. Our team includes a diverse array of talent including well versed Municipal Advisors, Project Managers, Certified Public Accountants, and specialists in other areas (human resources, work force planning, engineering, etc.).

You will work side-by-side with firm leadership and will be a apart of a group of talented staff. BT has the ability to provide you with amazing career experience working with some of the most entrepreneurial partners in our field.

You will enjoy this role if:
- You enjoy helping local governments and other entities meet their financial and community goals.  This role, specifically on the Baker Tilly Municipal Advisory team, will assist communities with meeting their public finance needs, including capital planning, issuance of municipal bonds, developing incentive packages, budgeting and state reporting requirements.
- You crave a leadership opportunity with a well-established public sector practice that continues to achieve tremendous growth.
- You want to be part of a firm that is invested in your success by providing the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow

What you will do:
- Assist public sector entities, mainly cities, towns, counties, redevelopment commission and economic development organizations, on their public finance needs and manage several projects simultaneously.
- Assist on management consulting projects for public sector organizations through financial management reporting, budget preparation and analysis, capital project planning, comprehensive financial planning, issuance of municipal bonds, utility rate studies, and related client services. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: - Preparing financial reports, research, and analysis
- Participating in client and working group meetings
- Presenting information to groups and clients
- Gathering data

- Learn and grow from direct on the job coaching and mentoring along with participating in firm wide learning and development programs.
- Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with clients.
- Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance.
- Occasional travel and mostly same-day travel within the state.
- Serve on client projects and assist in management of client relationships.
- Document and analyze processes, internal controls, and workflow to identify opportunities for improvement.
- Ensure alignment of resources – people, process, and technology – with key strategic goals and priority service areas.
- Develop tactical approaches to implement changes in strategy, service delivery, technology and/or policy.

Baker Tilly will offer you a variety of experience and the freedom to perform projects, meet clients and prospects that many firms would not at this level of experience. Your colleagues are fun, interesting, driven and have a strong desire to learn more about our business and grow our practice. You will have a defined long-term career path and your Performance Counselor will help guide you in your Baker Tilly career.

Qualifications
- A Bachelor's degree within business, finance, accounting, or public administration. MBA/MPA and/or Series 50 designation desirable but not a requirement.
- Two to three (2-3) plus years of progressive related consulting experience
- Knowledge of public sector operations broadly, specific knowledge or experience in a public sector setting - state or local government, public utility, and K-12 schools preferred
- Demonstrated management, analytical, organization, interpersonal, project management, communication skills, and highly developed Microsoft Suite skills (Word, Excel) required.
- Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning in order to stay current regarding applicable strategies, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties.

Job Description:

Join Baker Tilly’s Managed Services Advisory team and help clients transform how their finance and accounting functions operate. We partner with leaders to design modern operating models, streamline processes, and implement technology-enabled solutions that drive efficiency, strengthen controls, and elevate business insights.

As a Senior Manager, you’ll work with Baker Tilly’s cross-functional teams (Go-to-Market, Technology, Transition, and Operation) to solve complex operational challenges from strategy through execution. You will guide clients through assessments, design, transitions, and steady state operations while delivering best-in-class service and financial expertise.

In this role, you’ll act as a strategic advisor, using your knowledge of industry trends and operational best practices to provide actionable insights and help clients build scalable, high-performing finance organizations. Every team member plays a key role in advancing Baker Tilly’s mission to lead the market through purpose-driven, innovative solutions.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement end‑state Global Business Services (GBS) and operating models across Finance, HR, IT, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Customer Operations, including process architecture, governance, service catalogs, organizational structures, and global delivery models (captive, outsourced, hybrid).

- Assess organizational and process maturity, and develop transformation roadmaps aligned to enterprise strategy, value levers, and business outcomes.

- Lead large‑scale, multi‑process transformation programs, integrating automation, analytics, AI, RPA, and intelligent workflow platforms to drive efficiency, scalability, and service excellence.

- Establish enterprise service management and performance frameworks, including SLAs/OLAs, KPI hierarchies, dashboards, financial and operational reporting, and continuous improvement mechanisms.

- Drive transitions, migrations, and operational readiness across global delivery networks, including change management, knowledge transfer, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment.

- Partner with technology and digital teams to embed data platforms, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics into core GBS and finance operations.

- Serve as a trusted advisor on complex finance and operational transformation engagements, including outsourced CFO/Controllership, Record‑to‑Report, Procure‑to‑Pay, Order‑to‑Cash, FP&A, and Financial Reporting.

- Design and deliver future‑state finance processes and data models, including financial consolidation, close acceleration, chart of accounts design, planning/budgeting/forecasting, and enterprise financial intelligence (e.g. AI).

- Lead client engagements, from executive workshops and assessments through proposal development, transition, execution, and steady state operations.

- Direct and develop cross‑functional consulting teams, managing day‑to‑day delivery, quality, timelines, and client satisfaction across global stakeholders.

- Develop scalable dashboards, data models, and reporting solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, and Alteryx to support operational, financial, and strategic insights.

- A key leader in practice growth and go‑to‑market efforts, including managed services pursuits, thought leadership, reusable assets, sector‑specific offerings, and representation at executive forums and industry events.

- Mentor and develop junior and mid‑level team members, fostering a collaborative, high‑performance culture across global teams.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, MIS, or related field (Master’s preferred); CPA, CFA, PMP, or equivalent certifications strongly preferred.

- Eight (8)+ years of progressive experience in finance transformation, GBS, or management consulting with demonstrated leadership in operating model and process transformation.

- Proven expertise advising global organizations on GBS, shared services, outsourcing, and target operating model design, including BPO selection, contracting, transition, and performance management.

- Knowledge of Finance systems tools that includes ERP's, AI and FP&A tools

- Deep knowledge & demonstrated design through execution and process improvement & standardization Record‑to‑Report, Procure‑to‑Pay, Order‑to‑Cash, FP&A, and Financial Reporting.

- Strong consulting and delivery experience leading complex, multi‑stakeholder transformations across captive and outsourced environments.

- Experience working with Private Equity companies and their portfolio companies is plus

- Expert‑level proficiency in Power BI; strong working knowledge of Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and similar analytics tools.

- Advanced project and program management capabilities, including planning, risk management, executive reporting, and governance.

- Extensive experience designing data, reporting, and chart‑of‑accounts structures to enhance insight, decision support, and performance management.

- Strong executive presence with the ability to translate complex operational and financial concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leaders.

- Proven ability to build and sustain senior client relationships, support sales and proposal efforts, and influence strategic decision‑making.

Job Description:

Join Baker Tilly as a Managing Director in our fast-growing Financial Advisory Services team within the Office of the CFO practice. This is a leadership role within a rapidly scaling team focused on building a market-leading FP&A and finance transformation offering. We partner with CFOs, private equity sponsors, and executive teams to design, build, and operate high-impact finance functions that drive better, faster decision-making.

Our team supports a diverse client base—from high-growth, PE-backed portfolio companies to large enterprises—across industries including consumer products, manufacturing and distribution, technology, life sciences, healthcare, media and entertainment, and professional services. We deliver a broad suite of services spanning interim FP&A leadership, finance function stand-up, strategic planning, financial modeling, management reporting, and advanced analytics.

As a Managing Director, you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, capability building, and business development, helping shape the future of our practice while serving as a trusted advisor to senior finance leaders. This role is focused on ongoing FP&A, finance transformation, and value creation—not transaction execution—often working with clients post-investment.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Leadership & Delivery
- Serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs, private equity sponsors, and senior executives, delivering high-impact FP&A and finance transformation engagements.
- Lead complex client engagements across a broad suite of services, including: - Interim FP&A leadership and operational finance support
- FP&A function stand-up (people, process, and technology design)
- Budgeting, forecasting, and long-range strategic planning processes
- Advanced financial modeling (3-statement models, 13-week cash flow, scenario analysis)
- Management reporting design, automation, and performance insights
- KPI development and benchmarking, particularly within PE-backed environments
- Dashboarding and analytics solutions (e.g., Power BI)
- Cross-functional business partnering with sales, operations, and executive teams

- Support private equity-backed portfolio companies through value creation initiatives, including performance improvement, cash flow optimization, and finance infrastructure build-out.
- Oversee engagement execution, ensuring quality, timeliness, and profitability across multiple concurrent projects.

Practice Building & Capability Development
- Help define, build, and scale Baker Tilly’s FP&A and Office of the CFO capabilities, expanding beyond traditional strategic finance into a comprehensive, end-to-end offering.
- Develop and standardize methodologies, tools, and accelerators (e.g., forecasting frameworks, reporting templates, dashboard solutions).
- Collaborate across service lines (e.g., transaction advisory, tax, audit, consulting) to deliver integrated, cross-functional solutions.

Business Development & Market Presence
- Originate or expand client relationships, particularly within private equity firms and their portfolio companies, to drive new revenue and deepen existing accounts
- Lead proposal development and deal shaping, including scoping, pricing, and positioning of services
- Contribute to thought leadership, client presentations and market-facing content to enhance the firm’s brand in FP&A and finance transformation.
- Actively participate in go-to-market strategies targeting high-growth and PE-backed companies.

Team Leadership & Talent Development
- Help lead, mentor, and develop high-performing team members while fostering a culture of accountability, growth, and collaboration.
- Play a key role in recruiting and building out the team, particularly as the practice scales its capabilities.
- Provide technical guidance across financial modeling, FP&A processes, and client delivery.
- Operate as a player-coach, balancing hands-on problem solving with team leadership and oversight.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
- 10–15+ years of relevant experience, ideally with a mix of: - Big 4 or national accounting/consulting firm experience
- Corporate FP&A or finance leadership roles
- Direct experience working with private equity firms and/or PE-backed portfolio companies

- CPA, CMA, CFA, or similar credentials strongly preferred.
- Demonstrated experience leading finance transformation, FP&A build-outs, or operational finance initiatives.
- Strong understanding of private equity environments, including value creation, reporting expectations, and liquidity/cash management.
- Proven ability to lead multiple complex engagements and manage senior client relationships.
- Experience in business development, including winning new opportunities and contributing to revenue growth.
- Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities; strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
- Experience with FP&A and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar) strongly preferred.
- Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders.
- Strong project management and organizational skills in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
- Familiarity with US GAAP and broader finance/accounting processes.
- Ability to travel
This is a unique opportunity to join a high-growth, entrepreneurial team within a leading firm, where you will play a direct role in shaping the strategy, offerings, and trajectory of the Office of the CFO practice. You’ll have the opportunity to build something meaningful, work closely with firm leadership, and position yourself for continued advancement toward Principal.

The pay range for this position is $263,930 to $395,900. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly’s Strategy, People & Operations professionals help organizations define where they need to go and build the organizational capabilities needed to get there. We advise executive teams and boards on organizational strategy and transformation, bringing together considerations spanning organizational effectiveness, operating models, people and change, financial and operational performance, governance, process improvement, technology enablement and implementation.

As a Consulting Principal in Baker Tilly’s Strategy, People & Operations practice, you will serve as a senior, market-facing leader within Baker Tilly’s not-for-profit advisory practice. You will develop trusted executive relationships, originate and expand client opportunities, and lead complex advisory engagements that help mission-driven organizations strengthen performance, sustainability and impact.

The Principal will bring broad-based consulting expertise, with depth in one or more areas of Strategy, People & Operations and the ability to integrate specialists and capabilities from across Baker Tilly. ·       Identify, originate, qualify and advance new consulting opportunities through existing relationships, prospective clients, industry networks and collaboration across the firm.
·       Lead strategic pursuits, solution development, proposals, presentations and executive conversations for significant consulting opportunities.
·       Partner with industry, geographic, service line, marketing and other firm leaders to bring integrated Baker Tilly solutions to clients and the marketplace.
·       Build market visibility through industry relationships, executive forums, conferences, publications, presentations and other thought-leadership activities.
·       Maintain an informed perspective on emerging not-for-profit sector trends and translate market insight into relevant advisory solutions and new service opportunities.

Strategy, People & Operations Advisory
·       Shape and lead complex advisory engagements spanning organizational strategy, people, operations and transformation from assessment and strategy through implementation.
·       Advise executive teams on strategic planning and execution, organizational priorities, growth and sustainability, program and service portfolios, resource allocation, governance and performance.
·       Design and evaluate organizational and operating models, including organizational structures, roles and responsibilities, decision rights, functional alignment, staffing and capacity considerations, and opportunities to strengthen organizational effectiveness.
·       Advise organizations on leadership alignment, workforce capabilities, organizational culture, employee experience, succession considerations and readiness for change as components of broader organizational transformation.
·       Guide organizational and operational assessments that evaluate the interaction of people, processes, systems, organizational structure, financial resources and performance.
·       Advise clients on operational and functional transformation, including process improvement, performance improvement, cost and resource management, scalability, service delivery and technology enablement.
·       Help leadership teams strengthen financial sustainability and align resources, investments and organizational capacity with strategic and mission priorities.
·       Shape future-state visions, transformation road maps, implementation approaches, performance measures and governance structures that enable recommendations to translate into sustainable results.
·       Guide organizations through significant change by building leadership alignment, engaging key stakeholders, addressing implementation barriers and maintaining momentum.
·       Apply leading practices thoughtfully within the context of not-for-profit missions, governance structures, stakeholder environments, funding models and resource realities.

Not-for-Profit Sector Leadership
·       Apply a sophisticated understanding of the strategic and operating environment facing not-for-profit and mission-driven organizations to help clients balance mission impact with organizational capacity, financial sustainability, operational effectiveness and responsible stewardship of resources.

Job Description:

We are seeking a dynamic and highly experienced Managing Director to lead and expand our Financial Advisory Services (FAS) within the Office of the CFO Accounting Advisory practice. This role will specialize in advising clients on complex technical accounting matters and financial instruments, with a strong emphasis on financial services, digital assets, and fintech sectors. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in U.S. GAAP, IFRS, and regulatory frameworks, and will serve as a trusted advisor to CFOs and finance leaders navigating accounting complexities, transactions, and emerging financial technologies.

Key Responsibilities:
- Serve as a senior advisor to clients with deep technical expertise in financial instruments, derivatives, securitizations, digital assets and complex accounting issues

- Lead and deliver advisory engagements on complex accounting topics including:
- Consolidations (ASC 810)

- Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

- Leases (ASC 842)

- Business Combinations (ASC 805)

- Impairments (ASC 350/360)

- Share-based payments (ASC 718)

- Advise clients on classification, measurement, and disclosure of financial instruments under ASC 815, ASC 825, and IFRS 9

- Lead and deliver advisory engagements involving:
- Derivatives and hedge accounting

- Fair value measurements (ASC 820)

- Structured products, securitizations, and loan accounting

- CECL implementation and modeling (ASC 826)

- Advise on accounting policy development, restatements, and remediation of material weaknesses

- Build and grow client relationships with financial institutions, fintech’s, asset managers, and exchanges

- Build and maintain strong relationships with CFOs, Controllers, and Audit Committees.

- Drive thought leadership in emerging accounting topics, including evolving FASB and SEC guidance

- Stay abreast of regulatory developments (SEC, FASB, IASB, Basel III, etc.) and emerging technologies impacting financial reporting

- Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing teams; foster a culture of innovation and technical excellence

- Support business development, proposals, and go-to-market strategies for financial services and technical accounting services

- Collaborate cross-functionally with tax, risk, valuation, managed services, and technology teams to deliver end-to-end solutions

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a specialized field such as accounting, business, finance or related field – Master’s degree preferred.

- CPA preferred, CFA or other relevant certifications a plus

- 15+ years of relevant experience in financial services and/or technical accounting advisory, Big 4 or top-tier consulting preferred

- Industry experience in financial services (banking, capital markets, asset management, or insurance), digital assets, private equity, or fintech

- Deep expertise in financial instruments and financial services accounting

- Proven track record of leading complex engagements and managing senior client relationships

- Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver high-impact solutions in fast paced environments

- Attention to detail along with a commitment to quality and confidentiality.

- Ability to work extended hours including evenings and weekends, as well as the ability to travel overnight, as necessary.

Why Join Us:
- Lead a rapidly growing, high impact advisory practice

- Influence the future of financial reporting and digital finance

- Collaborate with innovative clients across traditional and emerging sectors

- Competitive compensation and flexible work environment

The compensation range for this role is $215,950 to $409,420. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
