Job Description:

Come join Baker Tilly's Development Advisory (DA) team as a Senior Associate, Capital Formation. In this role, you will support the evaluation, structuring, and execution of renewable energy transactions across various energy transition technologies. Leveraging financial modeling, transaction analysis, and market expertise, you will conduct due diligence, analyze project economics, and assess financing alternatives to support capital deployment decisions. Working alongside other investment professionals and collaborating with tax- and energy-related disciplines, you will help drive transactions from evaluation through close while navigating the evolving regulatory landscape of the renewable energy sector.

As one of the fastest-growing firms in the nation, Baker Tilly offers exceptional opportunities for career growth, flexibility in how and where you work, and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates, and leaders who genuinely care about your success and professional development.

Responsibilities:
- Evaluate investment opportunities in renewable energy infrastructure, including solar, storage, renewable natural gas, and hydrogen, through financial modeling and detailed analysis of project economics, cash flows, tax attributes, and risk-adjusted returns.
- Underwrite tax equity and other project finance transactions to optimize investor returns and capital efficiency.
- Collaborate with developers, sponsors, legal counsel, tax advisors, lenders, and other counterparties to support transaction execution, including due diligence, structuring, negotiations, and closing activities.
- Review project development assumptions, engineering reports, legal documentation, and third-party diligence materials to identify key investment risks.
- Prepare Investment Committee Memoranda, as well as marketing and business development materials necessary for capital aggregation and deployment.
- Conduct market research on financing structures, transaction activity, and regulatory developments related to renewable energy investments.

- 4-year degree
- 3 years professional experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Engineering, or related field.
- 3+ years of work experience in investment banking, private equity, corporate development, project finance, or consulting; Energy/Power industry exposure preferred.
- Experience building financial models, including 3-statement and tax equity models, cash flow projections, and other financial analyses to support investment decisions.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and manage multiple projects while maintaining a high standard of professional and ethical conduct.
- Strong analytical skills coupled with attention to detail; excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Job Description:

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing Advisory CPA Firms?
If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a Principal focused on Transaction Advisory Services. This is a great opportunity to lead buy-side and sell-side due diligence engagements from start to finish in a variety of industries. You will work side-by-side with firm leadership to serve clients and build the business, having a direct impact on the firm’s success. Additionally, you will be a mentor and coach to a group of talented staff, utilizing your expertise to help develop their technical and professional skills. If you are invigorated by these exciting challenges, then this could be the right opportunity for you! As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

You will enjoy this role if:
- You are looking for an opportunity to be a leader and industry expert to the clients you serve

- You can see yourself as a trusted business advisor, working face-to-face with clients to find creative solutions to complex accounting and business challenges

- You want to work for a leading CPA advisory firm in growth mode and you want the opportunity to continue building out our clients

- You want to contribute to your engagement team’s professional growth and develop your own leadership skills to build a career with endless opportunities  now, for tomorrow

What You Will Do:
- Be a trusted leader of buy-side and sell-side due diligence/quality of engagement

- Proactively engage with your clients throughout the year to understand business goals and objectives

- Beyond QOE engagements, advise, implement and deliver solutions to clients related to all other phases of the Merger & Acquisition life cycle

- Play an active role in providing valuable guidance and business recommendations

- Deliver business insight through thoughtful review, analysis, and discussion

- Manage cross-functional teams to deliver engagements and ensure client profitability targets are met

- Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally (especially with private equity firms) with the goal of acquiring new repeat referral sources, clients, projects, and revenue

- Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firmwide learning and development programs

- Support the growth and development of team members, helping associates meet their professional goals

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance required, master’s or advanced degree desirable

- CPA/CFA a plus

- Fifteen (15+) years’ experience providing transaction advisory services in a professional services firm required

- Must have experience with merger & acquisitions, and financial due diligence.

- History of relationships with private equity firms and their portfolio companies

- Demonstrated management, analytical, organization, interpersonal, project management, communication skills

- Ability to lead and supervise others, provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning in order to stay current regarding applicable strategies, see the "big picture" as well as the details, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of projects

Job Description:

The M&A Integration Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the successful integration of acquired CPA and professional services firms. This role serves as the central project leader from Letter of Intent (LOI) through post-close integration, ensuring acquired firms are successfully transitioned into the organization's people, processes, technology, and culture.

Working closely with Corporate Development, Executive Leadership, Finance, HR, IT, Operations, Marketing, Practice Leadership, and external partners, the M&A Integration Manager drives integration planning, governance, execution, and continuous improvement while minimizing disruption to clients and team members.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional project manager who thrives in a fast-paced, acquisition-driven environment and can influence stakeholders across multiple functions without direct authority.

Responsibilities:

I ntegration Leadership
Lead end-to-end post-merger integration activities across multiple concurrent acquisitions, developing and managing detailed integration workplans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and timelines. Coordinate integration activities from pre-close planning through operational stabilization. Support transition from due diligence to post-close execution, ensuring consistent execution of the firm’s Integration Playbook. Duties include:

Project Management
- Facilitate recurring integration meetings and executive steering committees.
- Monitor project health, timelines, risks, and dependencies.
- Maintain project dashboards and executive reporting.
- Escalate critical issues with recommended solutions.
- Manage multiple acquisitions simultaneously.
- Ensure accountability for deliverables while proactively identifying risks and removing roadblocks.

Change Management
- Support acquired firm leaders throughout the integration journey.
- Promote effective communication and organizational change.
- Assist with onboarding and orientation activities.
- Help preserve client relationships while integrating operational processes.
- Foster adoption of firm standards, systems, and best practices.

Stakeholder Communication
Serve as the primary integration contact for acquired firms.
Build trusted relationships with partners and firm leadership.
Prepare executive presentations, status updates, and reporting.
Communicate project progress, risks, and accomplishments to leadership.

Continuous Improvement
Process Improvement
- Continuously improve integration methodologies, templates, and playbooks.
- Capture lessons learned after each acquisition.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
- Support development of integration KPIs and performance metrics.

Cross-Functional Coordination
- Partner with functional leaders to coordinate integration and ongoing process improvement across: - Human Resources
- Information Technology
- Finance & Accounting
- Operations
- Marketing & Business Development
- Risk Management
- Practice Management
- Facilities
- Learning & Development

Qualifications :
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Management, or related field required
- 5+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional projects.
- Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
- Strong organizational and project management skills.
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Project or comparable project management software.
- Experience within a CPA firm, consulting firm, or professional services organization required.
- Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions or post-merger integration.
- PMP, CAPM, Prosci Change Management, Lean Six Sigma, or similar certification a plus.
- Familiarity with Smartsheet, Monday.com, Asana, Jira, or Microsoft Project required.
- Experience with CRM, ERP, HRIS, or practice management platforms a plus

Job Description:

Position Overview

The Director of Client Strategy & Growth serves as a strategic partner to the Practice Leader, with a dedicated focus on expanding market opportunities, strengthening client relationships, developing new business opportunities, and identifying what clients will need next across the mortgage industry.
This individual will combine deep mortgage industry expertise, an established network of industry relationships, strong client relationship skills, and a strategic growth mindset to help expand Baker Tilly's Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice across Mortgage Quality Control, Compliance, Servicing Quality Control, and related advisory services.

The Director will work closely with the Practice Leader to enhance the practice's ability to pursue new opportunities, deepen existing client relationships, increase market visibility, and proactively identify solutions to emerging client needs.

This role is intentionally different from a traditional Business Development position. The individual will collaborate with Baker Tilly's Business Development professionals while bringing the mortgage industry knowledge, executive relationships, client insight, and subject matter credibility necessary to develop opportunities and advance strategic client conversations.
The role is also designed to complement and enhance the Practice Leader's responsibilities. Overall practice strategy, operations, financial performance, service delivery, quality, client accountability, and people leadership remain the responsibility of the Practice Leader.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Growth & Market Development
- Partner with the Practice Leader to identify, develop, and advance growth opportunities across the mortgage industry.
- Leverage established industry relationships to create introductions and new opportunities with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, and other market participants.
- Identify prospective organizations and decision-makers that align with the practice's capabilities and strategic growth objectives.
- Develop relationships with executive-level decision-makers and influencers throughout the mortgage industry.
- Support the development of strategic pursuits from initial relationship development through solution discussions, proposals, and presentations.
- Bring mortgage subject matter expertise and industry credibility into prospective client conversations.
- Identify opportunities to expand the practice into new segments, relationships, and areas of the mortgage lifecycle.
- Partner with the Practice Leader on targeted market strategies based on industry developments, client needs, and emerging opportunities.
- Collaborate with Baker Tilly Business Development professionals to complement firmwide sales efforts with mortgage-specific relationships, market intelligence, and subject matter expertise.

Client Relationship Expansion & Client Success
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across existing clients.
- Enhance the Practice Leader's ability to maintain proactive executive engagement across a growing client portfolio.
- Develop a deep understanding of each client's business model, strategic priorities, challenges, and future objectives.
- Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships through additional Mortgage Risk Advisory services.
- Proactively identify additional ways Baker Tilly can provide value beyond the client's current scope of services.
- Support strategic client discussions and executive business reviews focused on future needs, industry developments, and opportunities.
- Gather client feedback and market intelligence that can help strengthen relationships and identify future opportunities.
- Help ensure clients continue to view Baker Tilly as a trusted advisor and strategic partner rather than solely a service provider.
- Support client retention through proactive relationship development, responsiveness, industry insight, and continued value creation.

Strategic Client Insights & Growth Opportunities
- Leverage client discussions, industry trends, engagement results, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for deeper client engagement and practice growth.
- Partner with the Practice Leader to identify emerging client needs and determine where additional services, solutions, or advisory support may create value.
- Recognize trends across the client base that may signal broader market opportunities or the need for new or expanded service offerings.
- Use knowledge of a client's business, strategic priorities, and challenges to proactively bring forward ideas and opportunities beyond the current engagement.
- Help develop executive-level conversations that shift relationships from individual services to broader strategic discussions around risk, compliance, quality, servicing, technology, and business priorities.
- Identify opportunities to connect clients with additional capabilities across the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice and broader Baker Tilly organization.
- Gather market and client intelligence that helps the Practice Leader determine where the practice should focus future growth efforts.
- Identify recurring client challenges that could be developed into scalable service offerings, advisory solutions, or targeted market initiatives.
- Help turn successful client solutions and outcomes into relevant market stories, thought leadership, and conversations with prospective clients.
- Proactively identify "what's next" for key clients—what challenges they are likely to face, what support they may need, and where Baker Tilly can engage before a formal need or opportunity is identified.

Mortgage Industry & Market Strategy
- Maintain a comprehensive understanding of developments across the mortgage lifecycle and the challenges affecting lenders, servicers, investors, and other industry participants.
- Monitor regulatory, agency, economic, technology, and market developments that could create new client needs or business opportunities.
- Translate industry developments into potential client conversations and market opportunities.
- Identify emerging areas where the practice can develop or expand capabilities to address changing client needs.
- Maintain awareness of competitor capabilities, market positioning, and service offerings to help identify opportunities for differentiation.
- Bring forward ideas regarding AI, automation, analytics, technology, and other emerging capabilities when they can create client value, support strategic growth, or create new service opportunities.
- Help the Practice Leader continuously evaluate where the mortgage market is heading and how the practice can remain ahead of changing client needs.

Industry Presence & Strategic Relationship Development
- Maintain and expand a strong network of relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
- Represent the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice at relevant conferences, associations, industry events, and client meetings.
- Build relationships with mortgage executives, technology providers, industry organizations, investors, and other strategic market participants.
- Identify opportunities for strategic introductions, partnerships, and industry collaboration.
- Support thought leadership, webinars, industry discussions, and other opportunities that increase visibility for the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice.
- Identify opportunities for the Practice Leader and other Baker Tilly leaders to engage with key industry decision-makers.
- Use industry relationships and market knowledge to identify prospective clients and emerging opportunities before they become formal pursuits.

Critical Skill Set
The ideal candidate will possess a unique combination of deep mortgage industry expertise, established relationships, strategic growth capabilities, client relationship skills, executive presence, and market awareness.

Deep Mortgage Lifecycle Expertise
The individual must possess comprehensive knowledge of the end-to-end mortgage lifecycle, including:
- Mortgage origination and loan manufacturing
- Processing and underwriting
- Closing and post-closing
- Mortgage Quality Control
- Regulatory compliance
- Operational and credit risk
- Servicing
- Default servicing and loss mitigation
- Investor and agency requirements
- Vendor oversight
- Mortgage technology and operational workflows

The individual should understand how these areas intersect and be able to recognize client challenges and opportunities across the mortgage lifecycle rather than having expertise limited to a single function.

Established Mortgage Industry Relationships
Deep, current industry relationships are a critical requirement for this position.
The ideal candidate will have:
- An established network of executive-level relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
- Current relationships with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, technology providers, industry organizations, and other key market participants.
- Relationships with senior decision-makers and influencers responsible for mortgage operations, quality control, compliance, risk, servicing, technology, and related functions.
- A strong professional reputation and demonstrated credibility within the mortgage industry.
- The ability to leverage trusted relationships to create introductions, open doors, initiate strategic conversations, and identify opportunities for Baker Tilly.
- Active involvement and continued visibility within the mortgage industry rather than relying solely on historical relationships.
- The ability to build new relationships while maintaining and expanding an existing industry network.

Strategic Growth & Opportunity Development
- Demonstrated ability to identify and develop business opportunities through relationships, industry knowledge, and consultative engagement.
- Ability to recognize opportunities before a formal RFP or buying process begins.
- Strong understanding of how to move an opportunity from an industry or client conversation into a meaningful strategic pursuit.
- Ability to identify opportunities within both existing and prospective client relationships.
- Consultative approach focused on understanding business challenges and developing solutions rather than transactional selling.
- Ability to connect client needs with capabilities across Mortgage Risk Advisory and the broader Baker Tilly organization.
- Strong market awareness and ability to recognize where industry changes may create future demand.

Client Success & Executive Relationship Management
- Demonstrated ability to develop trusted, long-term relationships with executive-level clients.
- Strong understanding of client success and proactive relationship management.
- Ability to understand a client's broader organization, priorities, challenges, and future direction.
- Ability to recognize opportunities beyond the current scope of an engagement.
- Strong listening and consultative problem-solving skills.
- Ability to navigate complex or sensitive client discussions while maintaining strong relationships.
- Strong executive presence and credibility with senior mortgage industry leaders.

Strategic & Commercial Acumen
- Ability to understand the business drivers of mortgage lenders and servicers and how market conditions affect their priorities.
- Strong understanding of how client challenges translate into advisory opportunities.
- Ability to evaluate the potential value and strategic fit of new opportunities.
- Ability to identify patterns across clients and the market that could lead to scalable service offerings.
- Strong understanding of competitive positioning and differentiation.
- Ability to balance client needs, market opportunities, and Baker Tilly capabilities when developing potential solutions.

Technology, AI & Emerging Market Awareness
While this is not an innovation or technology leadership position, the individual should maintain awareness of technologies changing the mortgage industry.
The ideal candidate should have:
- Working knowledge of AI, automation, analytics, and emerging mortgage technologies.
- Understanding of how technology is changing mortgage origination, servicing, compliance, quality control, and risk management.
- Ability to recognize practical opportunities where technology may address client challenges or create new advisory opportunities.
- Ability to engage internal Baker Tilly resources when specialized technology or AI expertise is needed.
- Curiosity and a forward-looking mindset regarding how the mortgage industry will continue to evolve.

Executive Communication & Influence
- Exceptional executive communication and presentation skills.
- Ability to lead strategic conversations with senior mortgage executives.
- Ability to translate complex mortgage issues into clear business discussions.
- Strong relationship-building and influencing capabilities.
- Ability to represent Baker Tilly professionally at conferences, client meetings, and industry events.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with Practice Leadership, Principals, Business Development professionals, delivery leaders, and other Baker Tilly service lines.
- Ability to influence and advance initiatives without direct operational authority.

Desired Experience & Qualifications
- 15+ years of progressive experience within the mortgage industry.
- Significant experience across multiple areas of the mortgage lifecycle rather than expertise limited to one function.
- Deep knowledge of Mortgage Quality Control, Compliance, Servicing Quality Control, Risk, and related mortgage functions.
- Established and current executive-level network within the mortgage industry.
- Demonstrated success developing and expanding strategic client relationships.
- Demonstrated ability to create business opportunities through industry relationships, market knowledge, and consultative engagement.
- Experience working with mortgage lenders, servicers, investors, mortgage technology providers, consulting organizations, or other organizations supporting the mortgage industry.
- Experience interacting with senior and executive leadership within mortgage organizations.
- Understanding of mortgage technology platforms, analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities.
- Demonstrated industry presence through mortgage associations, conferences, committees, advisory groups, speaking engagements, webinars, thought leadership, or other industry involvement.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What Success Looks Like
The Director of Client Strategy & Growth will enhance the Practice Leader's ability to expand and strengthen the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice by:
- Creating new relationships and developing qualified client opportunities.
- Leveraging existing industry relationships to expand Baker Tilly's reach within the mortgage market.
- Increasing opportunities within existing client relationships.
- Strengthening executive relationships and contributing to long-term client retention.
- Identifying changing client needs and helping determine where Baker Tilly can provide additional value.
- Bringing market intelligence and client insights to the Practice Leader that inform growth priorities.
- Identifying new or expanded service opportunities based on recurring client and industry needs.
- Increasing the practice's visibility and strategic relationships throughout the mortgage industry.
- Working effectively with Baker Tilly Business Development professionals to advance opportunities without duplicating their role.
- Serving as a trusted strategic partner to the Practice Leader and increasing the Practice Leader's capacity to execute growth and client strategies while the Practice Leader retains overall responsibility and accountability for the strategy, leadership, operations, financial performance, delivery, quality, clients, and people of the Mortgage Risk Advisory Practice.

The pay range for this position is $127,500 to $294,300. This range represents a good-faith and reasonable estimate of the compensation the firm expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will depend on a variety of relevant factors, including an applicant’s skills, experience, qualifications, professional certifications, work arrangements, geographic location, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range, and compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. Baker Tilly offers a compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Job Description:

Baker Tilly has an incredible career opportunity for a Senior Consultant, Forensic Accountant to join our growing London Forensics, Litigation & Valuation Services (FLVS) team.  As a part of our team, you will find that our global brand and entrepreneurial environment will give you the support you need to build your career across a wide range of forensic and litigation services to meet our client’s most important needs. You will also contribute to some of the most important activities in our firm which include operating and growing the business, serving the client, developing the best people, and shaping our culture.

Senior Consultants on our FLVS team will conduct and prepare a wide range of forensic financial analyses. A Forensic Accountant has a unique job which requires strong analytical, creative, investigative, research, communication, and organisational skills, as well as familiarity with a variety of the field’s concepts, practices, and procedures. Forensic Accountants will maintain excellent client relationships by delivering high quality client service.

You will enjoy this role if:
- You are looking for your next challenge, crave variety where no day is the same, and feel your skills and experience can be better utilised.
- You maintain excellent client relationships by delivering the highest level of client service.
- You are a team player with strong communication skills and desire to work collaboratively with others to meet client needs.
- You are naturally curious, able to spot the unusual, and have a tenacity to discover the cause.
- You have a willingness to look at detail, without missing or losing sight of the ‘big picture’.
- You have a readiness to accept that everything one does might be challenged and have the confidence and resilience to handle this as well as pressure and deadlines.
- You feel valued when you are provided the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow.

Responsibilities:
- Work closely with the Principal / Director on a wide variety of projects. Able to work autonomously and be responsible for directing staff, instructing them in work to be performed, reviewing their completed work and directing any necessary revisions or actions.
- Assist in performing forensic financial analyses, building models, maintaining documents.
- Discuss and outline problems/ issues with the Senior Manager, Director or Principal and then act on the preferred advice.
- Determine engagement timelines, in conjunction with the engagement lead, and instructs assistants in time management methods allowing them to efficiently and effectively accomplish the Firm’s objectives.
- Manage day-to-day project activities; establish appropriate leverage on project teams and assign/manage project responsibilities to team members.
- Carry out the quantification of claims on behalf of Insurers, Loss Adjusters, Lawyers, and others.
- Analyse data and financial / non-financial information and apply a forensic approach to the work.
- Assist in preparing clear, concise reports which can be understood by non-accountants.
- Be flexible and responsive to client needs, being available for meetings at times and places stipulated by the client. This can involve working long days and to tight deadlines
- Develop and maintain excellent client relationships.
- Team player who works well with all other team members.
- Participate in Firm business development efforts, including the development of presentations and proposals.
- Represents the Firm at business and community functions to maintain existing client relationships.

Qualifications:
- A minimum of 2 years of post qualified experience or related experience
- Candidates should be exam qualified with post-qualification experience as ACA or ACCA
- A record of progressively increasing knowledge, skill, responsibility, and independence
- Experience in forensic accounting and litigation support is strongly preferred
- Individuals in this position must have demonstrated computer skills and experience with accounting software, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint
- Must be willing to work non-traditional business hours to meet client demands if required
- Confidence to handle confrontation, pressure and deadlines
- Candidates with language skills are encouraged to apply
- Candidates with a proven industry experience outside of traditional accounting i.e. energy, mining, or construction sectors are encouraged to apply
- Skilled at building relationships with others
- Able to work in the UK without sponsorship (unfortunately we cannot accept spouse/ graduate visas).
- Fluency in English is required

Job Description:

This leader is directly responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities within the Construction, Hospitality & Professional Services (CHPS) sector in an assigned territory, while building, managing, and expanding strong client relationships.

The Director serves as a key member of the CHPS Industry Practice leadership team, partnering with practice leaders to shape and execute go-to-market strategies and drive industry-focused growth initiatives. This includes collaborating across service lines to develop innovative, value-driven solutions that support organizations across construction, infrastructure development, hospitality, restaurants, and professional services firms. This position requires a strong understanding of market dynamics, operational transformation, capital investment cycles, labor and workforce pressures, and regulatory considerations impacting CHPS sectors. It is critical to enhancing Baker Tilly’s market position and delivering differentiated value to clients navigating project-based revenue models, margin pressures, labor constraints, evolving customer expectations, and digital transformation.

You will have the opportunity to:
- Understand key industry service offerings and confidently communicate their application across the CHPS ecosystem—including construction, real estate development, hospitality and leisure, and professional services firms—to a diverse group of stakeholders

- Demonstrate an understanding of core industry challenges, including project execution, cost control, labor shortages, supply chain disruption, customer experience, and operational efficiency, and their impact on client growth strategies

- Monitor and communicate emerging trends such as infrastructure investment, real estate development cycles, travel and hospitality demand shifts, private equity investment, and digital enablement to identify and develop new business opportunities

- Lead the deployment of sales techniques and strategies to integrate services and resources across all lines of service and geographies

- Account Ownership; Strategic Account Management

- Possess a broad understanding of macroeconomic, regulatory, and market trends impacting CHPS sectors, including interest rates, capital availability, labor dynamics, and economic cycles affecting construction and hospitality demand

- Have a conversational understanding of the firm’s significant service offerings beyond CHPS that intersect with our team's expertise, enabling the utilization of the firm's strategy to deliver and enhance value in an integrated and mutually reinforcing marketplace

- Build, maintain, and expand relationships across the CHPS ecosystem, including contractors, infrastructure operators, hospitality and restaurant brands, professional services firms, investors, and strategic partners

- Perform regular, aggressive, and prompt follow-up on all Firm-generated leads assigned from campaigns, or ad hoc requests from practice leadership

- Maintain a clear understanding of target clients and segments for business development purposes—and why

- Track and analyze emerging CHPS industry trends and innovations to identify potential opportunities

- Regularly inform practice leadership of changing market dynamics and other factors influencing accounts of strategic importance

- Maintain strict compliance with CRM (Salesforce) requirements by consistently documenting opportunity notes and all related activities, and keeping an accurate, up-to-date pipeline of qualified opportunities in accordance with firm protocols

- Attain closed business revenue goals associated with both new accounts and existing client accounts (as appropriate), ensuring a profitable return to the Firm each fiscal year

- Participate as a key team member on all relevant market development meetings and other in-house discussions

- Create, sustain, and grow relationships with new and existing clients through regular, open communication; ensure performance standards and client satisfaction are consistently met, and proactively communicate and troubleshoot issues as they arise

- Maintain deep knowledge of core service offerings and effectively position their application within target CHPS markets to influence decision-makers

- Collaborate with other BD leaders and practice leaders for an integrated Go-to-Market (GTM) approach

- Perform account planning and key account research to optimize business development efforts and account penetration

- Perform primary outreach efforts and coordinate with marketing personnel on campaigns including prospect calls, emails, and other mechanisms to secure appointments with key stakeholders

Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of a degree.

- 10+ years of experience in construction, infrastructure development, hospitality, restaurant, professional services, or related industries, or in professional services supporting these sectors (e.g., accounting, consulting, engineering, or advisory), required

- Demonstrated understanding of industry-specific dynamics, including project-based revenue models, capital investment cycles, and operational challenges

- Familiarity with construction project lifecycles, hospitality operations, or professional services business models is preferred

- Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and thought leadership skills

- Strong understanding of emerging technologies and their business applications

- Ability to work under a defined and planned directive with minimal direct day-to-day supervision for implementation

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Ability to travel 50–80% as needed

Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Other compensation for this role may include performance and sales-based commissions.

Job Description:

Responsibilities

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the areas of risk and advisory?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as an IT Audit, Cybersecurity & Risk Manager (HITRUST) ! Our Risk Advisory practice provides a full spectrum of services to help our clients assess their risks, develop strategies to compete in an ever-changing business environment, and achieve their goals and objectives.  All of this is accomplished through deep industry knowledge of risk, governance, internal audit, compliance, IT, and cybersecurity best practices.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

Does this describe you?
- You want to continue to expand your work experiences and hone your skills as a comprehensive risk professional in the areas of compliance, enterprise risk management, governance, internal controls, and data analytics

- You crave the opportunity to be part of a fast growing, entrepreneurial risk consulting practice where your hard work and creativity will be rewarded

- You do your best work when you are part of a talented, down-to-earth team that thrives in collaboration and truly enjoys working together

- You feel valued when you are provided the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow

What you will do:
- Work closely with client executives and management teams to understand their businesses and assist in identifying and managing financial and operational risks within their business processes and systems
- Develop in-depth knowledge of clients’ businesses and industries by having direct client interaction while working on multiple aspects of an engagement

- Think independently and strategically about your clients’ business, systems and risks p roviding recommendations for business and process improvements based upon knowledge gained relative to the client’s operations, processes and business objectives

- Provide strategic business advice to clients by assisting in the implementation of new processes and controls that address key risks

- Assess, manage and optimize information technology risk across a wide range of areas, including cybersecurity, IT strategy and governance, IT regulatory and compliance requirements, and business continuity and disaster recovery.

- Review clients' processes and controls against industry frameworks, identifying gaps in design and execution, and communicating issues and recommendations to clients

- Draft comprehensive executive summaries and final reports for delivery to the client, documenting and reviewing engagement work papers in accordance with industry-accepted internal audit methodologies

- Act as a valued business advisor, build relationships and communicate effectively with the client to provide superior client service

- Facilitate professional and effective presentations to internal and external audiences

- Continue to develop your knowledge and experience working with a variety of technology environments, platforms, applications and tools/utilities

- Assist with managing client engagement staffing, billings/collections, and ensure client profitability targets are met

- Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with clients and the community

- Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs

- Support the growth and development of team members through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals

- Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance

- CPA, CISA, CCSFP or CISSP designation(s) required

Preferred Qualifications:

- CPA, CISA, CCSFP or CISSP designation(s) required

Job Description:

Baker Tilly's NetSuite Solutions practice is one of the fastest-growing technology consulting groups in the firm. As an Oracle NetSuite partner operating under a Transaction Management Agreement (TMA), we now sell both the NetSuite license and the implementation services that surround it — giving us a complete, differentiated offering in the mid-market ERP space.

We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own net-new pipeline creation for this practice. This is a hunting role, not an account-management role. You will build pipeline three ways: (1) sourcing net-new prospects in the open market, (2) activating Baker Tilly's internal network of audit, tax, and advisory partners to open doors into their client base, and (3) developing the Oracle NetSuite field sales relationships that drive co-sell and referral volume. Success is measured in qualified opportunities created and sourced closed-won revenue — license and services.

The role suits a self-directed seller who is comfortable operating inside a professional services firm, working an ERP sales cycle that runs three to nine months, and partnering with solution consultants and delivery leaders rather than carrying the technical demo themselves.

Responsibilities
Pipeline creation
- Net-new sourcing. Own a personal quota of qualified net-new opportunities. Identify, prospect, and qualify mid-market companies whose growth stage, systems pain, or event triggers (funding round, acquisition, QuickBooks/legacy ERP ceiling, audit finding, new CFO) make them viable NetSuite candidates.
- ICP discipline. Work an ideal-customer-profile and scoring framework rather than a spray-and-pray list. Prioritize accounts by fit, timing, and reachability; document why an account is in play.
- Campaign and event follow-up. Convert webinar registrants, conference contacts, and marketing-sourced leads into live conversations on a defined cadence. Don't let a warm lead go cold in the CRM.

Internal network activation
- Cross-practice door-opening. Baker Tilly has thousands of existing audit, tax, and advisory clients that are prime NetSuite candidates. A large share of our best deals start as an internal referral. You will systematically work Baker Tilly partners and managing directors — by industry team and by geography — to surface those clients and earn the introduction.
- Referral engine. Build a repeatable rhythm (briefings, one-pagers, industry-team meeting slots, referral tracking) so that internal referrals become a predictable channel rather than an accident.

Oracle NetSuite alliance
- Field alignment. Build and maintain working relationships with NetSuite Account Executives, Channel Managers, and Alliance Managers in your territory. Understand how deal registration, PDR, and the TMA/resale motion work, and use them to your advantage.
- Co-sell. Bring NetSuite AEs into deals where a joint pursuit wins, and be the partner they call first when they need an implementation partner for their own pipeline.

Deal progression and handoff
- Qualification. Run first meetings and discovery conversations to a defined qualification standard (business pain, decision process, timeline, budget, sponsor). Protect the practice from unqualified pursuits.
- Pursuit teaming. Partner with Solution Consultants, delivery leaders, and practice leadership on demos, scoping, estimates, and proposals. Own the relationship and the close plan; let the technical team own the solution.
- Executive relationships. Establish credibility with CFOs, Controllers, COOs, and IT leaders — the people who actually sign an ERP decision.

Discipline and reporting
- CRM hygiene. Maintain accurate, current activity, opportunity, and forecast data in the practice's CRM. Pipeline reporting rolls up directly from your records; if it isn't in the system, it doesn't exist.
- Forecast accuracy. Provide honest, defensible commit and upside calls. Practice leadership makes staffing and hiring decisions off this data.
- AI-enabled selling. Baker Tilly's NetSuite practice is investing heavily in AI-driven business development — automated prospect research, scoring, outreach sequencing, and proposal generation. You will be expected to use these tools and help improve them.

Qualifications
- 5 years minimum; 8 years preferred of quota-carrying business development or new-logo sales experience with a documented record of hitting or beating a net-new number.
- Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of a degree.
- Experience selling technology, software/SaaS, or professional services into the mid-market.
- Demonstrated ability to build pipeline from a cold start — not inheriting a book of business.
- Comfort selling to finance and operations executives; ability to hold a credible conversation about business process pain without being a technical practitioner.
- CRM discipline (Salesforce, NetSuite CRM, or similar).
- Willingness to travel (roughly 25–40%) for prospect meetings, internal office visits, and industry events.
- ERP experience — NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics, or a comparable mid-market platform — on either the software or the channel-partner/VAR side.
- Experience working within or selling alongside a channel/alliance partner ecosystem.
- Depth in one or more of our core verticals: manufacturing/distribution, food & beverage, life sciences, professional services, retail/consumer, or nonprofit.
- Experience selling inside a professional services firm, where the internal referral network is a primary channel, and influence matters more than authority.

The pay rate range for this job position is $78,800 to $175,530. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Other compensation for this role may include performance and sales-based commissions.

Job Description:

The Business Development Director at Baker Tilly is a senior-level, strategic role focused on accelerating growth across the firm’s Tax, Assurance, and Advisory practices. This role is directly responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities within the Private Client sector in an assigned territory, while building, managing, and expanding strong client and referral relationships.

The Director serves as a key contributor to the growth of the Private Client Practice, partnering with practice leaders to shape and execute go-to-market strategies and drive market-focused growth initiatives. This includes collaborating across service lines to develop innovative, value-driven solutions that support high-net-worth individuals, family enterprises, privately held business owners, family offices, trusts, estates, foundations, and the advisors who serve them.

This position requires a strong understanding of tax planning, estate and trust matters, succession planning, family office operations, business transition strategies, regulatory considerations, and the evolving needs of affluent individuals and families. It is critical to enhancing Baker Tilly’s market position and delivering differentiated value to clients navigating complex personal, business, and family financial matters.

You will have the opportunity to:
- Understand key Private Client service offerings and confidently communicate their application to high-net-worth individuals, family enterprises, privately held business owners, family offices, trusts, estates, foundations, and their advisors
- Demonstrate an understanding of estate and gift planning, trust and fiduciary considerations, family governance, succession planning, liquidity events, business transition planning, and family office services and their impact on client goals and decision-making
- Monitor and communicate emerging trends related to tax legislation, wealth planning, estate and gift planning, family office evolution, business succession, liquidity events, and generational wealth transfer to identify and develop new business opportunities
- Lead the deployment of sales techniques and strategies to integrate services and resources across all lines of service and geographies
- Possess a broad understanding of macroeconomic, regulatory, tax, and market trends impacting affluent individuals, family enterprises, privately held businesses, and family offices
- Have a conversational understanding of the firm’s significant service offerings beyond Private Client that intersect with our team's expertise, enabling the utilization of the firm's strategy to deliver and enhance value in an integrated and mutually reinforcing marketplace
- Build, maintain, and expand relationships across the Private Client ecosystem, including family office executives, attorneys, wealth advisors, private client bankers, trust officers, investment advisors, business owners, and other centers of influence
- Perform regular and prompt follow-up on all Firm-generated leads assigned from campaigns, or ad hoc requests from practice leadership
- Maintain a clear understanding of who your team wishes to target for business development purposes – and why
- Regularly inform practice leadership of changing market dynamics and other factors influencing accounts of strategic importance
- Maintain strict compliance with CRM (Salesforce) requirements by consistently documenting opportunity notes and all related activities, and keeping an accurate, up-to-date pipeline of qualified opportunities in accordance with firm protocols
- Attain closed business revenue goals associated with both new accounts and existing client accounts (as appropriate), to ensure a profitable return to the Firm each fiscal year
- Participate as a key team member on all relevant market development meetings and other in-house discussions
- Create, sustain, and grow relationships with new and existing clients through regular, open communication; ensure performance standards and client satisfaction are consistently met, and proactively communicate and troubleshoot issues as they arise
- Maintain deep knowledge of core service offerings and effectively position their application within target markets to influence decision-makers
- Collaborate with other BD leaders and practice leaders for an integrated Go-to-Market (GTM) approach
- Perform account planning and key account research to optimize business development efforts and account penetration
- Perform primary outreach efforts and coordinate with marketing personnel on campaigns including prospect calls, emails, and other mechanisms to secure appointments with centers of influence, referral sources, and prospective clients

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent years of experience in lieu of a degree.
- 10+ years of experience in Private Client, Family Office, Trust and Estate, Wealth Management, Private Company Advisory, Tax Advisory, or related industries, or in professional services supporting these sectors (e.g., accounting, law, tax advisory, family office advisory, or consulting), required
- Minimum of 10 years of experience selling or delivering tax, assurance, and/or consulting services within Private Client, Family Office, Wealth Management, Trust and Estate, or related advisory environments, required
- Demonstrated understanding of wealth transfer planning, estate and gift taxation, trust and fiduciary matters, family office operations, business succession planning, family enterprise governance, and the complex advisory needs of affluent individuals and families
- Experience building relationships with centers of influence, referral networks, and executive-level decision-makers within the Private Client ecosystem
- Demonstrate strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and thought leadership skills
- Strong understanding of emerging technologies and digital solutions supporting client service delivery, relationship management, and business development
- Ability to work under a defined and planned directive with minimal direct day-to-day supervision for implementation
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Ability to travel up to 50% as needed

The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Other compensation for this role may include performance and sales-based commissions.

In San Fransico, California the pay rate is: $191,800-$303,310

As we continue to grow our Transaction Advisory Services practice, we are seeking to add an Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will provide due diligence and transaction advisory services to our clients to meet their complex financial needs.

Our clients include privately held and publicly traded companies, private equity funds, mezzanine funds, banks, private debt funds, and business development companies. This multi-faceted client base allows us to provide our staff with a variety of opportunities across numerous industries, and a constant flow of challenging and meaningful work.

What You Will Do:
- Interact directly with Partners on matters related to client and engagement management.
- Data gathering, document review and preparation of quality of earnings reports.
- Research and financial analysis of target companies.
- Due diligence for both buy side, sell side, and corporate finance transactions.
- Communication with clients to ensure delivery of exceptional client service.
- Opportunities for career development and to advance within the transaction advisory services group.

Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree required
- At least one year of related experience required
- Experience in Audit or Transaction Advisory preferred
- Professional designations or candidacy (CPA) and / or an advanced degree are a plus
- High motivation, initiative and positive attitude
- Excellent organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to multitask and handle multiple priorities appropriately
- Ability to work autonomously, to meet tight deadlines, and to thrive in a fast paced
environment with shifting priorities
- Excellent verbal and written communication, experience presenting analyses to
management and ability to lead and drive initiatives
- Ability to work effectively and thrive in a team environment with all levels of client personnel in various industries
- Ability to comfortably interact with senior level client personnel, including supporting the preparation of and participating in executive briefings

Job Description:

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the areas of risk and advisory?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a Senior Consultant (Life Sciences – Compliance ) ! Our Risk Advisory practice provides a full spectrum of services to help our clients assess their risks, develop strategies to compete in an ever-changing business environment, and achieve their goals and objectives.  All of this is accomplished through deep industry knowledge of risk, internal control, governance, compliance, and internal audit best practices.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

You will enjoy this role if:
- You want to continue to expand your work experiences and hone your skills as a comprehensive risk professional in the areas of compliance, enterprise risk management, governance, internal controls, and data analytics

- You crave the opportunity to be part of a fast growing, entrepreneurial risk consulting practice where your hard work and creativity will be rewarded

- You do your best work when you are part of a talented, down-to-earth team that thrives in collaboration and truly enjoys working together

- You feel valued when you are provided the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow

The senior consultant position will be actively involved in a variety of projects, with a focus on the life sciences industry.  The selected candidate will use their industry knowledge and technical, analytical and research skills in support of our clients’ project needs in the practice areas of life science compliance and ethics.

Responsibilities will include:
- Participate in a variety of healthcare projects including: compliance program development; reimbursement policy research and analysis; data analysis and summarization; fair market value analysis economic modeling for emerging technologies and strategic planning activities; regulatory compliance and risk assessment; due diligence, and commercialization strategy development.

- Project responsibilities may include:
- Analyzing large data sets and identifying and interpreting patterns and trends in the data

- Advising clients on appropriate business conduct and related trainings

- Conducting research (e.g., performing surveys and interviews, reviewing government and healthcare policies and procedures)

- Evaluating business processes, identifying opportunities for improvement and making recommendations to clients

- Managing multiple client-related priorities concurrently and resolve issues accordingly

- Communicating project status regularly with project managers

- Writing client reports including summarization of project objectives, approach and results

- Participate in writing peer reviewed publications

- Monitoring project time and deadlines to ensure completion of the project within estimated timeline and budget

- Participate in industry conferences and professional organizations

- Remain current on technical topics and industry trends as they relate to firm and client activities

Minimum Required Qualifications:
- 4 year degree

- Three (3) years of experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in science, business or related program

- MPH/MBA/MHA or master’s degree in healthcare preferred

-  3+ years of progressive work experience in the healthcare industry with some combination of the following skills preferred:
- Analysis of healthcare data

- Physician compensation analysis

- Knowledge of global spend transparency reporting requirements (e.g. US Sunshine Act)

- Provide research and analysis within the life sciences sector

- Assess health and performance of client businesses

- Strong analytical skills including proficiency in data manipulation and financial modeling

- Strong writing skills (experience in assisting with and/or authoring peer reviewed publications preferred)

- Proficiency with Excel; must have data analytics experience and SAS experience highly preferred (or proficiency in SQL or R) experience with other analytical tools (e.g., Access, Tableau, SPSS) a plus

- Experience in the life sciences sector highly preferred

- Performance/operational improvement expertise is a plus (e.g., Six Sigma)

- Self-motivated and can work independently

- Time management skills; ability to manage multiple client related priorities

- Strong written, verbal and presentation skills

- Creative and innovative thinker

- Willingness to travel up to 25% and ability to work non-traditional hours due to client engagements

Job Description:

Our Purpose:
Our purpose is to help build a financial services industry for middle market (company with revenue btw $200 million to $5 billion) in which middle market financial institutions are trusted and flourish, and the global economy is healthy, growing and secure.  If you have a passion for rallying together to solve complex challenges, then join our dynamic growing team.  We help client with transactions life cycle (IPO, SPAC, merger, divesture), implement new accounting (US GAAP or IFRS) or regulatory rules, implement or remediate internal controls and transform or digitize their finance functions as well as implement ESG, etc...  Sounds interesting?  If this is you, please reach out to us to discuss further your interest and qualifications.

The opportunity:
Our Financial Advisory Services (FAS) team is growing exponentially and as a Manager you’ll play a key role in that growth to help us achieve our vision 2030. Strategy 2030 will navigate us toward our objective of becoming the leading middle market advisory firm, growing to $5 billion and continuing to ascent in the profession.  Working across all key financial service sectors, you’ll develop your career by communicating creative, strategic goals both internally and externally. It’s all about listening to and understanding our middle market clients to give them a truly exceptional client experience in a field where there really are no off-the-shelf recommendations.

Baker Tilly is currently searching for a Manager to join our FAS practice. Our practice helps CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Directors improve the financial reporting processes to ensure that finance adds value to business operations.  The FAS practice enables finance executives to achieve significant and sustainable performance through technical analysis and process improvement services.

Our clients range from emerging growth companies to publicly traded companies across financial service sectors. Baker Tilly's FAS team is comprised of practitioners across the country. Our goal is to solve problems or make improvements that will free the finance organization up so that they can focus on growing and improving their overall business.

This practice area has professionals with multi-disciplines and experiences that are drawn upon to assist our clients with very practical and hands-on support.  We have senior team members that have served as Chief Financial Officers, Controllers, financial statement auditors, and financial analysts that are all highly credentialed. It is a high performing team that enjoys learning from one another and serving our clients.

Your responsibilities:
- Actively participate in projects focused on the following service offerings in financial services:

- US GAAP Advisory

- Business Analytics and Decision Support

- Financial Accounting Advisory Services

- Transaction Support

- Finance transformation

- Program/Project Management

- Supervise, develop and train staff on engagements. Participate actively in the team’s work on a project (i.e. “roll up your sleeves” and work with the team)

- Interact directly with senior managers and partners on matters related to client and engagement management

- Strengthen existing client relationships and developing new business opportunities by providing outstanding client service while also expanding our footprints across other functional areas at clients.

- Communicate with business owners, executive management, investors, lenders and other sophisticated parties to ensure delivery of exceptional client service

- Be accessible and anticipate client needs, questions, and issues

- Invest in professional development through active participation in training sessions and networking events both internally and externally

- Assist with recruiting activities to include campus recruiting along with referring experienced individuals to the firm and participating in the firm's Employee Referral Bonus Program

- Contribute to firm’s efforts to attract, retain, and develop staff and seniors and act as mentor for other senior & staff

- Demonstrate excellent team skills, positive attitude and high ethical standards

- Lead by example to positively impact employee morale to help build and maintain our inclusive culture

- Set and achieve challenging profitability, billing, and collection objectives consistent with circumstances of the engagement, proper utilization of staff, and attention to risk management

- Develop and maintain relationships with colleagues in the office, other service lines, and engagement/project teams

- Regularly look for opportunities, recommendations, and additional firm services that could benefit or add value to our clients

Successful candidates will have:
- 5+ years' experience in a large accounting firm in audit, financial advisory service line in financial services industry

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or related

- Certified public accountant (CPA), or CMA preferred

- Knowledge and ability to use appropriate tools, applications, and accounting and finance concepts to facilitate analysis. Skills with Power BI and/ or Tableau is a plus.

- Current US GAAP and/or IFRS advisory knowledge and application

- Exposure to Middle Market financial suite of applications, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, IntAcct, etc. , their functionality, workflows, automated controls, and associated facilitation of data consolidation, reporting, and robust analytics and their relationship to addressing myriad business requirements

- High motivation, initiative and positive attitude

- Excellent organizational skills with a demonstrated ability to multitask and handle multiple priorities appropriately

- Advanced modeling and excel skills, experience conducting complex quantitative and qualitative financial analysis and ability to generate data-driven insights

- Ability to work autonomously, to meet tight deadlines, and to thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

- Excellent verbal and written communication, experience presenting analyses to management and ability to lead and drive initiatives

- Ability to work effectively and thrive in a team environment with all levels of client personnel in various industries

- Ability to comfortably interact with senior level client personnel, including supporting the preparation of and participating in executive briefings

What we look for:
- We’re interested in versatile people with the ability to take on new responsibilities and listen to clients to get things done. We’re not just looking for technical accounting experience but broader controllership and operational experience including finance transformation — we’re after genuinely interesting people with the ability to build relationships, negotiate and think in unique and creative news ways. If you’re a confident leader with a curious mind and the ability to solve complex issues, this role is for you.

The compensation range for this role is $124,910 to $236,800. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Job Description:

The Marketing Director leads the marketing function throughout the firm and provides strategic leadership of the marketing team to drive firm growth. The director leads a team of experienced marketers and collaborates with them to develop and implement marketing plans aligned with firm and business unit growth objectives, execute strategic marketing programs and actions, and proactively identify new opportunities to achieve growth goals.

The Marketing Director works closely with the Senior Director of go-to-market, firm leaders, principals, and marketing team leaders to set the direction and execution of marketing strategies and tactics. Responsibilities:

- Build and maintain collaborative, high performing engaged marketing team that provides value-added support to firm

- Provide guidance, coaching, and leadership to marketing team for ongoing career development and share positive feedback

- Hold regular marketing team meetings to build teaming and collaboration, share ideas, and provide information

- Five (5) years of experience

Job Description:

Are you interested in joining one of the fastest growing consulting and accounting firms in the country?

Would you like the ability to join a highly dynamic team focused on providing exceptional client service in the areas of risk and advisory?

If yes, consider joining Baker Tilly (BT) as a Financial Institution Senior Consultant (SOX and FDICIA Controls) ! Our Risk Advisory practice provides a full spectrum of services to help our clients assess their risks, develop strategies to compete in an ever-changing business environment, and achieve their goals and objectives.  All of this is accomplished through deep industry knowledge of risk, governance and regulatory compliance best practices.

As one of the fastest growing firms in the nation, BT has the ability to offer you upward career trajectory, flexibility in how and where you get your work done and meaningful relationships with clients, teammates and leadership who truly care about you and your development.

Does this describe you?
- - You want to continue to expand your work experiences and hone your skills as a comprehensive risk professional in the areas of compliance, enterprise risk management, governance, internal controls, and data analytics.
- You crave the opportunity to be part of a fast growing, entrepreneurial risk consulting practice where your hard work and creativity will be rewarded
- You do your best work when you are part of a talented, down-to-earth team that thrives in collaboration and truly enjoys working together
- You feel valued when you are provided the resources and support to continually sharpen your technical skills and build your career now, for tomorrow

What you will do:
- - Work closely with client executives and management teams to understand their businesses and assist in identifying and managing regulatory compliance risks within their business processes and systems
- Directly assist clients in notably being compliant with new or update in financial institution regulations
- Implement new or updated regulatory requirements, and translate regulatory requirements to ensure financial institution compliance
- Continually stay up-to-date on all existing compliance regulations
- Develop and maintain a broad knowledge and awareness of the financial institution industry and regulatory changes and identify potential impacts to compliance audit programs
- Support our internal audit practice as Subject Matter Expert on regulatory and compliance topics
- Provide strategic business advice to clients by assisting in the implementation of new regulatory requirements
- Assist with managing client engagement teams, along with staffing, billings/collections, and ensure client profitability targets are met
- Utilize your entrepreneurial skills to network and build strong relationships internally and externally with clients and the community
- Invest in your professional development individually and through participation in firm wide learning and development programs
- Support the growth and development of team members through the Baker Tilly Care and Teach philosophy, helping associates meet their professional goals
- Enjoy friendships, social activities and team outings that encourage a work-life balance

Minimum Required Qualifications:
- 4 year degree
- Three (3) years of experience

Preferred Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related program
- 3+ years of direct, hands‑on experience with SOX and/or FDICIA internal control programs within the financial services industry, with banking experience strongly preferred • Demonstrated experience with internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), including process and control documentation, walkthroughs, risk and control assessments, control testing, evaluation of control design and operating effectiveness, identification of control deficiencies, and remediation
- Demonstrated ability to execute key components of SOX and/or FDICIA programs, including coordination with process and control owners, internal audit, external audit, and other key stakeholders
Prior experience in a client-serving consulting, advisory, or public accounting environment supporting financial institution clients and/or experience within a financial institution’s SOX/FDICIA, internal controls, internal audit, or related risk function
- Experience communicating control observations, testing results, deficiencies, and remediation matters to client stakeholders and engagement leadership
- CIA or CPA designation(s) strongly preferred. Candidates interested in obtaining a CIA or CPA certification in the future are also encouraged to apply
- Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand business processes, identify risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls
- Exceptional verbal and written communication, collaboration, project management and time management skills
- Strong sense of urgency and client responsiveness
- Ability to travel up to 10%
